environment.description: Same application deployed behind pgBouncer 1.21 in transaction pooling mode with disable_pqexec=1 and a custom query filter (pgbouncer.ini: ignore_startup_parameters=extra_float_digits; server_reset_query=DISCARD ALL). pgBouncer is configured with max_client_conn=100, default_pool_size=20, and crucially uses statement-level connection assignment with prepared statement protocol enforcement. The pg connection string points to pgBouncer on port 6432. Additionally, the infrastructure includes an Envoy sidecar proxy (v1.28) with an HTTP connection manager filter chain that enforces HTTP/1.1 strict parsing with reject_chunked_trailer=true, max_request_headers_kb=60, and a custom Lua filter that normalizes Transfer-Encoding headers before forwarding to the Node.js process. The Envoy listener binds on port 8080 and forwards to localhost:4000.
